jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Unexpected Weight
jokes.joke: I knew I wasn’t built to be rich and famous when I lost my composure at a self-checkout. Celebrities survive paparazzi, lawsuits, and public scandals. I got psychologically broken by a machine accusing my bananas of being an unexpected item.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: My Agent's Rejection Speech
jokes.joke: I fired my talent agent last month. Not because he was bad at his job — because he was TOO honest about it. I called him crying after another rejection, and he goes, "Look, I'll be straight with you. I've gotten dogs more callbacks than you." I said, "That's insane, I have range!" He said, "Yeah, the dog has an agent AND a lawyer." I lost it. Full meltdown, screaming into the phone. And he just says, calm as ever, "See, THAT'S the emotional range I need on tape."

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Hotel Tantrum
jokes.joke: I'm at that awkward level of success where I'm not quite rich and famous enough to throw a proper tantrum at a hotel front desk. I tried it last week. I slammed my hand down and yelled, "Do you have any idea who I am?!" The clerk just sighed, tapped his screen, and said, "Yeah, you're the guy whose debit card just declined for a mini-bar Toblerone."

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Agent's Promise
jokes.joke: I finally got a talent agent who swore he'd make me rich and famous. Moved to LA, quit my day job, the works. Last week he calls me all excited: 'Kid, you're blowing up!' Turns out he meant my credit score. Now he's rich from my advance, driving a Tesla, while I'm famous for being the cautionary tale at open mics.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Agent Problems
jokes.joke: I tried to get a talent agent because I figured being rich and famous sounded nice. He asked what my talent was, and I panicked and said, “I can eat an entire rotisserie chicken alone in my car.” He nodded like that was normal and said, “Great… but can you do it on camera?”
